27/// Canonical bot archive extension, emitted by all write/creation paths.
28constexpr std::string_view kBotArchiveExtension = ".superdex_bot_archive";

30/**
31 * @brief Recognize a bot archive file path by extension.
32 *
33 * Always accepts the canonical @ref kBotArchiveExtension (`.superdex_bot_archive`).
34 * In internal builds (@c MOCHI_INTERNAL) it additionally accepts the legacy extensions for backward
35 * and Meta internal compatibility; public/OSS builds recognize only the canonical extension.
36 *
37 * @param[in] path The file path to test.
38 * @return @c true if @p path ends with a recognized bot archive extension.
39 */
40[[nodiscard]] MOCHI_API bool IsBotArchivePath(std::string_view path);

42/**
43 * @brief Parameters for @ref ArchiveBot.
44 */
45struct ArchiveParams {
46 /// Path to the source `.superdex_bot` file.
47 DynamicString src;
48
49 /// Path to the destination `.superdex_bot_archive` file. Parent directories are created if they
50 /// do not exist.
51 DynamicString dst;
52
53 /// Optional comment to include in the archive root metadata. Metadata already includes the
54 /// date, source content hash, and the commit hash from which the archive was produced.
55 std::optional<DynamicString> comment;
56};
57
58/**
59 * @brief Metadata stored at the root of every `.superdex_bot_archive` file.
60 *
61 * Serialized as JSON to a `.mochi_bot_archive_metadata` entry inside the archive zip.
62 */
63struct BotArchiveMetadata {
64 /// The date the archive was created (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD).
65 DynamicString date;
66 /// The hash of the source `.superdex_bot` file at the time of archiving (matches @ref
67 /// HashBotFile of the source).
68 DynamicString botHash;
69 /// The commit hash of the source code at the time of archiving.
70 DynamicString commitHash;
71 /// Archive-root-relative path of the `.superdex_bot` file that should be loaded from the
72 /// archive. Joined with the extracted directory by @ref GetExtractedBotArchiveTarget.
73 DynamicString target;
74 /// Optional comment provided by the user when the archive was created.
75 std::optional<DynamicString> comment;
76 /// Every asset the source tree could not supply when the archive was written: a file the bot
77 /// names that was missing, or a sensor params file that could not be parsed. An archive mirrors
78 /// the tree it came from, gaps included, so these record what was already absent rather than
79 /// anything archiving did wrong. Empty for an archive built from a complete tree.
80 DynamicArray<DynamicString> warnings;
81
82 MOCHI_STRUCT_BEGIN(superdex::robotics::BotArchiveMetadata)
83 MOCHI_FIELD(date)
84 MOCHI_FIELD(botHash)
85 MOCHI_FIELD(commitHash)
86 MOCHI_FIELD(target)
87 MOCHI_FIELD(comment)
88 MOCHI_FIELD(warnings)
89 MOCHI_STRUCT_END()
90};

92/**
93 * @brief Archive a `.superdex_bot` file and all its transitive dependencies into a self-contained
94 * `.superdex_bot_archive` zip file.
95 *
96 * Recursively collects every referenced file — other `.superdex_bot` files
97 * (@ref ModBotPrefab::base, @ref AttachBot::path, @ref ReplaceLinkWithBot::path) and
98 * model assets (`shapeFile`, `renderModelFile`) — then
99 * compresses them into a single zip file at the destination.
100 *
101 * The archive mirrors the on-disk multi-root topology rooted at the deepest common ancestor
102 * of all involved `.superdex_root` directories: each source root is laid out at its
103 * relative offset under the archive top, and one (possibly rewritten) `.superdex_root`
104 * file is included per source root. Tags whose target is not in the archive are dropped;
105 * surviving tags are rewritten to the relative path between the archived roots so cross-root
106 * `@tag` references continue to resolve.
107 *
108 * Errors out if the involved `.superdex_root` directories share no common ancestor (e.g.
109 * different Windows drive letters). The destination path must end with `.superdex_bot_archive`.
110 *
111 * @param[in] params Archive parameters (source bot, destination `.superdex_bot_archive` path).
112 * @param[in,out] error Error status. Check @ref Error::IsOK for success.
113 *
114 * @see LoadBotPrefabFromFile, which can transparently load a bot from a `.superdex_bot_archive`.
115 */
116MOCHI_API void ArchiveBot(ArchiveParams const& params, superdex::Error& error);
117
118/**
119 * @brief Extract a `.superdex_bot_archive` zip file into a deterministic location under the OS
120 * temp directory and return the resulting path.
121 *
122 * The destination directory is keyed on the archive's content hash (via @ref HashGenericFile),
123 * so identical archives share an extracted directory across calls and processes regardless of
124 * path or modification time, while modified archives are re-extracted into a fresh directory.
125 *
126 * @param[in] archiveFile Path to a `.superdex_bot_archive` zip file.
127 * @param[in,out] error Error status. Check @ref Error::IsOK for success.
128 *
129 * @return Path to the extracted directory, or an empty path on failure.
130 */
131[[nodiscard]] MOCHI_API DynamicString
132ExtractBotArchiveToCache(std::string_view archiveFile, superdex::Error& error);
133
134/**
135 * @brief Resolve the absolute path of the target `.superdex_bot` file inside an extracted archive.
136 *
137 * Typically called immediately after @ref ExtractBotArchiveToCache to determine which
138 * `.superdex_bot` file inside the extracted directory should be handed to a @ref FileBotLoader.
139 *
140 * @param[in] extractedDir Directory produced by @ref ExtractBotArchiveToCache (or any directory
141 * containing a `.mochi_bot_archive_metadata` file at its root).
142 * @param[in,out] error Error status. Check @ref Error::IsOK for success.
143 *
144 * @return Absolute path to the target `.superdex_bot` file, or an empty path on failure.
145 */
146[[nodiscard]] MOCHI_API DynamicString
147GetExtractedBotArchiveTarget(std::string_view extractedDir, superdex::Error& error);
148
149/**
150 * @brief Read the metadata written at the root of an extracted bot archive.
151 *
152 * @details Companion to @ref GetExtractedBotArchiveTarget, which reads the same file for its target
153 * alone. Use this to inspect @ref BotArchiveMetadata::warnings and learn which assets the source
154 * tree could not supply, without having to load the bot first.
155 *
156 * @param[in] extractedDir Directory produced by @ref ExtractBotArchiveToCache.
157 * @param[out] error Set if the metadata file is missing or cannot be parsed.
158 *
159 * @return The archive's metadata; a default-constructed value on error.
160 */
161[[nodiscard]] MOCHI_API BotArchiveMetadata
162ReadBotArchiveMetadata(std::string_view extractedDir, superdex::Error& error);

189/* @brief Archive a .mochi_bot_scene file and all its transitive dependencies into a
190 * self-contained .mochi_bot_scene_archive zip file.
191 *
192 * Collects all transitive dependencies — the base scene and its nested prefabs/shapes,
193 * spawnable prefabs, bot archives, and controller param files — then mirrors the on-disk
194 * multi-root topology (identical to the strategy used by @ref ArchiveBot) so that path
195 * resolution works identically after extraction.
196 *
197 * Requirements:
198 * - Every bots[].path must reference a .superdex_bot_archive (raw .superdex_bot is rejected).
199 * - params.src must end with .mochi_bot_scene.
200 * - params.dst must end with .mochi_bot_scene_archive.
201 *
202 * @param[in] params Archive parameters (source `.mochi_bot_scene`, destination
203 * `.mochi_bot_scene_archive` path).
204 * @param[in,out] error Error status. Check @ref Error::IsOK for success. */
205MOCHI_API void ArchiveBotScene(ArchiveParams const& params, superdex::Error& error);
206

211 * @return Path to the extracted directory, or empty on failure. */
212[[nodiscard]] MOCHI_API DynamicString
213ExtractBotSceneArchiveToCache(std::string_view archiveFile, superdex::Error& error);
